measurement.runtime: Installed Standard binary in native game mode outside editor UI; not exported release app

target.scope: Observed current 2NPC/2vehicle V0 load; adoption decision in R02, no 120FPS or larger-crowd guarantee

exported_app_bytes_reason: Subsequent R03 static package size observation, not a value measured during the original R01 benchmark. See R03 final package evidence for execution acceptance.
unavailable_reason: No documented script GPU frame timing or queried temperature sensor; engine CPU/physics monitors and screen records retained with their semantics.

saved_negative_controls.scope: Exact retained-data patches on passing B smoke; not six engine fault injections.

A.review: Opened actual 1920x1080 capture; same Daehanmun-facing camera, HUD intentionally hidden for benchmark, simplified city geometry and source boundary lines visible.

B.review: Opened actual 1920x1080 capture; same Daehanmun-facing camera, HUD intentionally hidden for benchmark, simplified city geometry and source boundary lines visible.

limitations: One ordered A then B run on this M1 with ordinary background applications; no actor-cost causal claim from B p95 being lower.
Camera replay benchmarks display/actors; it does not replace physical walking or new-aspect camera collision validation.
Engine MEMORY_STATIC is not RSS; retained 1Hz observations also consume memory. No unlimited-session leak-free claim.
No exported-package, M4 Pro, human handling, real terrain, location accuracy or public-distribution acceptance.

subsequent_r03_package_observation.scope: Package inventory size only; the R01 benchmark remains native Standard binary outside editor UI with its documented HUD/measurement conditions.
